description: A beautiful mobile-first travel social app where users post travel journeys in a flowchart-based format integrated with maps.

theme.vibe: Premium, adventurous, cinematic, mysterious, and highly structured. Feels like a high-end expedition log.

layout_and_spacing.general: Mobile-first approach. Use generous paddings for cards (p-6, p-8). Container width max-md for web viewing to simulate mobile frame.
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: Use gap-4 or gap-6 for tight widget clustering in the Explore section.
layout_and_spacing.navigation: Floating glassmorphic bottom tab bar (Home, Explore, Create, Profile) with backdrop-blur-xl and 1px border-white/10.
layout_and_spacing.flowchart: Vertical timeline layout. Use absolute positioned glowing lines (w-0.5 bg-gradient-to-b from-[#D4AF37] to-transparent) to connect nodes.

buttons.primary: bg-[#D4AF37] text-black font-bold rounded-full px-6 py-3 hover:-translate-y-1 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(212,175,55,0.3)] transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-white/5 text-white border border-white/10 rounded-full px-6 py-3 hover:bg-white/10 transition-all

component_styles.cards: bg-[#121415] border border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-2xl
component_styles.glass_panels: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#1C1F22]/60 border border-white/10 rounded-3xl saturate-150
component_styles.inputs: bg-[#0A0A0A] border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white focus:border-[#D4AF37] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#D4AF37] transition-all
component_styles.map: Use dark theme map styling. Overlay UI should float above the map using glassmorphism.

Auth.layout: Fullscreen background image with topographic map texture. Glassmorphic card in center or bottom sheet.

Home_Feed.layout: Vertical scroll of full-width or edge-to-edge images (max-h-[70vh]). Gradient overlay at bottom (bg-black/0 to bg-black/90) containing user info, title, and action buttons.

Create_Quest.layout: Wizard/Form interface. A list of nodes (Location, Activity) that user can add to. Connected by dashed lines.

Quest_Detail.layout: Hero image at top. Below, a cinematic vertical flowchart. Each node is a card with photos, notes, lat/lng.
Quest_Detail.visuals: Flowchart nodes glowing with ambient shadow. Tracing beam effect on scroll.

Map_View.layout: Fullscreen map. Numbered pins for each stop. Horizontal scrollable bottom sheet for node details.

Profile.layout: Hero user info (avatar, bio, stats like 'Traveler Rank', 'Badges'). Masonry or 2-column grid of their quests.
Profile.components: Stats widgets (Control Room grid style), Quest Thumbnails.

Explore.layout: Bento grid of trending quests and categories.
Explore.components: Asymmetric bento boxes (Tetris Grid) with rich imagery and minimal text.

backgrounds.description: Use as full-screen background for Auth and Create screens with 30% opacity.
Use as ambient background texture for the Quest Detail page.

feed_images.description: Sunset mountain view for feed post
Scenic landscape from OnQuest original site

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid based on their role (e.g., data-testid='create-quest-btn').

icons.usage: Use stroke-width 1.5 for a premium, delicate feel. Combine with absolute positioning to overlap on images where needed.
